name: A. F. Kay
guide_text: Value generator or scaling 4 drops are by far the best ones, such as [[Seafloor Recruiter||126916]] or [[Bigwig Bandit||122179]]. Same thing with value generating 3 drops, such as [[Accord-o-tron||98576]].
buddy_guide_text: The best ways to buff this buddy are Deep Blue Nagas, or blood gems from T4 Quilboars. Buffing this buddy is incredibly powerful, especially with [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]]. If you have a huge unit and roll into [[Channel the Devourer||100899]], it may be correct to sell most your board to eat your biggest minion onto the AFK buddy. A huge AFK buddy is gamewinning.
